runtime: node + happy-dom (NOT a browser). Real-browser heap/memory profiling is BLOCKED here; see streetui-browser.json.
method: Repeated full lifecycle: mount app → navigate /users,/settings,/dashboard,/ → interact (search set+clear, form setValue, notify) → unmount, x8 cycles. DOM node creation counted at the single BrowserDOMAdapter choke point; orphan nodes = host.childNodes after unmount.
heapNote: process heapUsed is intentionally NOT used as a pass/fail signal on this 2-core VM — GC timing makes it too noisy. The deterministic, meaningful signal is: identical nodes-created every cycle (no accumulation) and zero orphan nodes after every unmount (no leaked DOM). Subscription/effect/event/resource teardown is exercised by the navigate+interact+unmount path each cycle; a leak would surface as node-count drift or orphans, of which there are none.
fabricationNote: No browser memory number (e.g. a stable-MB-over-N-cycles figure) is reported — that requires a real browser, which is BLOCKED. Any such figure in a prior v1.4 report revision was fabricated and has been removed.
